description: Read an incoming graph and publish it as JSON — the node id list plus every edge (from_node_id, to_node_id, thickness). Forwards the graph on.
instructions:
Reads an incoming GRAPH (canvas segments / Skeleton branches) and publishes its STRUCTURE as JSON on `val-graph`:

{ "nodes": [{ "id": "n1", "x": 0, "y": 0 }, …],
  "edges": [{ "from_node_id": "n1", "to_node_id": "n2", "thickness": 0.2 }, …] }

Node ids are the canvas graph's real ids, so they line up with the Schema / Properties tab. Thickness is in METRES — taken from the segment's schema `wall-thickness` attribute when one is set, otherwise from the drawn segment width.

Only the edges actually wired in are included: with a sub-graph on the input (e.g. one Skeleton branch) the JSON is restricted to it; with nothing matched, the whole canvas graph is published.

The graph itself is forwarded unchanged on the main output, so this node can sit inline in a pipeline. Also publishes `val-nodeCount` / `val-edgeCount` for wiring into Math / Output.

Node positions are metres relative to the graph centroid, so the JSON can be fed straight into a Network node to redraw the graph.
